C0.quote: This paper studies aggregation of preferences under ignorance
C0.note: The paper is about Harsanyi-type aggregation of decision-theoretic preferences (maximin and alpha-maximin over sets of lotteries) under a Pareto axiom. It uses no ballots, votes or voting rule, and the main results are impossibility and possibility theorems for social welfare-style aggregation. This is not a voting procedure, so coding stops.
